sub_questions.question: Why does it say I'm out of credits when I haven't used the app much?
Can you fix this (restore the ability to use the app)?

claims.claim: Credit allowance differs depending on the workspace plan.
claims.guide_evidence: Sandbox | Free | 200 credits, one-time (does not renew)

claims.claim: On the free Sandbox plan, the 200 message credits are a one-time allowance that doesn't renew.
Even light use can exhaust the Sandbox credits.
claims.guide_evidence: A workspace that mostly uses a heavier model will exhaust its credit balance noticeably faster than the headline credit number suggests.

claims.claim: On Professional or Team, credits reset monthly.
claims.guide_evidence: waits for the next monthly credit reset (paid plans)

claims.claim: Some model responses cost more credits than others, so a heavier model can burn through the balance faster than expected.
claims.guide_evidence: Message credits are not consumed at a flat rate. Each model response is metered in credits according to the specific model used

claims.claim: The Billing page shows which plan the workspace is on and its remaining credits.
Options to resolve include connecting your own provider key or upgrading.
claims.guide_evidence: model calls on Dify-hosted credits stop working until the workspace either connects its own API key for that provider or waits for the next monthly credit reset

customer_safety_issues: Internal debug line leaked to customer: '[debug] intent=billing_plans confidence=low route=auto_send'
evaluation.rationale: The substance of the answer is well grounded in the guide: Sandbox credits don't renew, paid plans reset monthly, credit cost depends on the model, and the fixes are connecting your own key or upgrading. Asking which plan the customer is on is a sensible clarification. However, the reply ends with an internal debug line showing intent, confidence and routing values, so it can't go to the customer as is. It also says, without support from the guide, that the Billing page shows remaining credits, and it doesn't mention that only owners and admins can open that page.
